name: Parkour
about: Joins a game of Parkour that players voted open and walks him to the finish. Start it with !parkour in Telegram or the raw command {"cmd":"parkour"}; {"cmd":"parkour","on":false} stops him and takes him out of the game. He refuses a game the server opened by itself, which pays its winner. Every game he is in is recorded to parkour-runs.jsonl.
needs: The module's jar (Game, Advanced: Server modules: tweakcraft) and the profile's eventLeave command, with which he leaves the game.
